Container.Name: snorcal
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted 3D slicing hub for OrcaSlicer and BambuStudio. Single container — no sidecars required. The slicer binary is fetched on first boot from the SimplyPrint/slicer-builds nightly release and cached in the app data volume.
First launch shows a setup screen to set a login password (auth is on by default). Override SNORCAL_PASSWORD_HASH to preconfigure.
Slicing uses the same executeLocal code path as bare-metal — no HTTP sidecar — so Docker output matches bare-metal. External sidecars still supported via SLICER_URL_* if set.
Memory: give it 4G. Slicer + node + Xvfb need headroom.
Container.Requires: None. Single container with bundled Xvfb + GL/GTK libs. Slicer fetched at first boot. Redis optional (in-process slicing by default).

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Port the backend listens on. Default 3654. Pick a free host port if 3000 is taken.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage: SQLite DB, models, gcode, print photos, AND the cached slicer binaries (/data/slicers/). Wiping this loses everything.

Config.Name: SLICER_ENGINE
Config.Description: Which slicer(s) to fetch on first boot: orca | bambu | both. Default orca. Cached in /data/slicers/. Change env + clear the subdir to re-fetch.

Config.Name: SNORCAL_PASSWORD_HASH
Config.Description: OPTIONAL. scrypt hash of the login password. If unset, first launch shows a setup screen to pick one. Generate with: pnpm --filter backend exec tsx scripts/hash-password.ts

Config.Name: SNORCAL_AUTH_DISABLED
Config.Description: DANGER: set to 1 to disable auth entirely (every route open). Only for fully trusted isolated networks.

Config.Name: SLICER_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Override the slicer download source (e.g. pin a specific release tag).

Config.Name: REDIS_HOST
Config.Description: OPTIONAL. Redis hostname for BullMQ job queue. Leave blank to run slices in-process (recommended for single-user).

Config.Name: REDIS_PORT
Config.Description: OPTIONAL. Redis port. Only used when REDIS_HOST is set.

Config.Name: NODE_ENV
Config.Description: Set to production so backend serves the bundled frontend.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for timestamps in logs and job records.

Config.Name: DEBUG_PRINTER
Config.Description: Set to 1 to enable verbose MQTT/printer adapter logs.
